name: Ground 3 Corners

weightBudget.basis: One 35 mm sandstone pavement tile, rounded cobbles and shallow joints; 1024/512 colour atlases, lower resolution normal/ORM and Meshopt geometry.

reviewNotes: PDF page 2. Three sandstone corner caps around the gravel bed; native 35 mm base and 10 mm insertion depth, maximum z=19.179 mm. Height mask separates raised sandstone from brown ground; center remains free and stand height is ray-measured. UV uses individually checked 0.55 rad split and 0.0025 margin. Warm sandstone palette from author PDF; albedo-only correction retains all accepted geometry and PBR data maps.
